note: What a guide value means as a yes/no/not-applicable, independent of the words a particular hospital chose. Ordered: the first rule whose pattern matches wins. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the cleaned value. Anything unmatched is descriptive and flagged for review, and a value under review may be shown and answered but never drives a cascade or a gate.

rules.why: The field does not apply to this hospital's workflow at all.

A flat no. Anchored at the start, because a value may mention something being unavailable in a trailing clause while the field itself is available: 'Daily 0700-1900; continuous EEG unavailable' is a schedule, not a no.
The answer branches on time, consult type or another condition, so no single value is correct on its own.
A yes, including a yes with a qualifier or a requirement stated as an instruction.
Availability is stated as days and/or hours. The schedule grammar in time.ts decides whether the window is open now; this only records that the value is a schedule.
